verdict.rationale: Apify is a usage-billed SaaS platform, so whether exceeding a plan's credit or request quota leads to overage charges or a hard cutoff is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents what happens when a plan limit is exceeded. The only pricing-related item is a community compliment on the pricing page's mobile layout, which says nothing about overage behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether exceeding my plan's monthly credit or request quota triggers overage charges or a hard cutoff
